title: Hypothetical layered retry ceilings
method: Assume 100 logical operations. Nested SDK and application limits of 3 attempts yield 100×3×3=900; one coordinated 3-attempt policy yields 300. Upper bounds assume all failures are retry-eligible; no recovery rate is implied.
alt: Hypothetical layered retry ceilings. Nested three-attempt loops: 900 HTTP attempts; One three-attempt policy: 300 HTTP attempts. Illustrative inputs.
